title: Tighten a string list to a closed union without breaking the ratchet
prompt: In src/utils/workerRole.ts, LIVE_ROLE_ENV_VARS and RETIRED_SEAT_ENV_VARS are typed as plain `readonly string[]` while every value is one known env spelling. Tighten both to closed literal tuples (`as const`, with a derived union type for the members), fix any resulting type errors in consumers WITHOUT weakening other types (no `any`, no assertions that erase the union), and keep the strict typecheck floor green: `bash scripts/typecheck/run-all.sh` must report no new breaks.
